headline: Brothers Trading Private Limited files SEBI Reg 31(4) disclosure for substantial acquisition in Nimbus Projects Limited
sum: Brothers Trading Private Limited has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4) in relation to a substantial acquisition of shares in Nimbus Projects Limited, disclosed via NSE on 22 June 2026.
detail: The disclosure was submitted by Brothers Trading Private Limited to NSE under the mandatory framework of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. Regulation 31(4) requires that once an acquirer crosses prescribed thresholds (typically 5% voting rights or appointment to board), an open disclosure must be filed within two trading days of the trigger event. The filing is lodged in the NSE corporate archives, classifying this as a public takeover event subject to SEBI scrutiny and minority shareholder protections.
